notes: Labeled dataset for RAG/LLM evaluation (faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall, answer correctness, citation-set precision/recall). Mirrors backend/benchmarks/citation_grounding_benchmark.json's case shape, but inherits that file's current state honestly: per the Phase 1 audit, every case there is still 'excluded_unlabeled' -- the two-labeler adjudication process was designed but never completed. This file ships empty rather than copying those still-unlabeled cases in as if they were ready. Schema per labeled case: {"case_id": str, "question": str, "reference_answer": str (optional -- enables answer_correctness), "gold_citation_ids": [chunk_id, ...] (optional -- enables citation_set_precision/recall), "labeling_status": "labeled"}.
